page.intro: Kopwe fiti om kewe account. Ekkewe chon emwen seni om kewe ad ra tori non Ai kewe chon emwen non pwisin ar fansoun, ren moni tonong me monien emon me emon chon emwen.

connect.title: Kopwe riri LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sipwe fiti ewe LinkedIn mi nemeni om kewe ad. Leadrat a chok anneani om kewe taropwen ad, Lead Gen Form emwen me ekkewe pisekin ad, me a tinato ekkewe siwin ka siwini.
connect.need1: Ew wis won ewe nenien ad LinkedIn (Chon nengeni ika nap seni).
connect.need2: Ew wis won ewe pekin kompani mi ririfengen (Chon nemenem, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Chon tumunu ika chon anapanapa) - LinkedIn a mochen pwe epwe aporausa ekkewe chon emwen.
connect.need3: Ew kapas eis ren nampaan fon won noumw Lead Gen Forms - ekkewe chon emwen ese wor nampaan fon rese tongeni apachanong.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Kopwe ereni LinkedIn menni me nein noun kewe chon emwen ra winiti wesewesen chon apinukunuk. Nupwen emon chon emwen LinkedIn a tori ew napanap ka finata fan, Leadrat epwe repotei ngeni LinkedIn , ina minne om kewe repotun angangen achocho ra pwarata napanapen chon emwen me LinkedIn epwe tongeni kuna chommong aramas usun om kewe chon emwen mi murino. Ewe chok ID ren chon emwen LinkedIn me ew chok hash ren ewe email ra titito.
